title: Home Delivery Pharmacy Billing Office Rule: Order Cancellations and Account Credits
content:
## Billing office rule: cancellations and credits on Home Delivery Pharmacy orders

**Rule.** A member may cancel a Home Delivery Pharmacy order up to the program's last cancellable stage, which is before dispensing under every program; once dispensed it cannot be cancelled, and dispensed medication is never returned for credit. An order may be cancelled only when it has neither shipped nor been cancelled already. A cancelled order is never charged; a pharmacy-error credit equals the full member charge of the credited order and reverses its deductible and out-of-pocket postings. A small balance at or below the program's small-balance write-off figure is credited with the reason small balance write-off only when the account closes.

### Cancellation test, read from the order's own events

| Order already shipped | Order already cancelled | May be cancelled |
|---|---|---|
| No | No | Yes |
| Yes | No | No |
| No | Yes | No |

### Credits at a glance

| Credit | Amount | Effect beyond the balance |
|---|---|---|
| Pharmacy error | the full member charge of the credited order | its deductible and out-of-pocket postings are reversed |
| Small balance write-off | the small balance at or below the write-off figure | posted only when the account closes |

### Hypothetical cases

1. An order dispensed in error carried a member charge of 36.40, of which 20.00 was a deductible portion. The pharmacy-error credit is 36.40, and the deductible and out-of-pocket postings of that order are reversed.
2. A member asks to cancel an order that has already shipped. It cannot be cancelled, and the medication is not taken back for credit.
